review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md and README.md read fully; SCHEMA.md and WORKFLOW.md read for repository and audit context.

findings.symptom: The mathematical expression `f(t)=exp(-t^2)` is plain prose with no math delimiters, so it renders in the text face rather than as mathematics; adjacent formulas in the same step are typeset. This is a source-level notation formatting issue, not a KaTeX parser failure.
findings.suggested_repair: Set the expression in math delimiters, for example `$f(t)=e^{-t^2}$`, consistently with the surrounding formulas.

diagram_candidates.claim: For the fair nearest-neighbour chain on E_N={0,...,N} with absorbing endpoints, the probability of hitting N before 0 from i is i/N.
diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: finite-state Markov transition graph with harmonic values
diagram_candidates.concrete_content: Draw ordered states 0,1,...,N on a horizontal path. Give states 0 and N absorbing self-loops with probability 1; give each interior state arrows to its two neighbours labelled 1/2. Under each state i annotate the hitting probability i/N, and label the boundary payoff 0 at state 0 and 1 at state N. Include the formula P_i(T_N<T_0)=i/N.
diagram_checks: For N=1, show only the two absorbing boundary states and no interior transitions.
For N>=2, every interior row has exactly two outgoing transitions, each of probability 1/2; endpoints have only a probability-1 self-loop.
The displayed harmonic values satisfy g_N(0)=0, g_N(N)=1 and g_N(i)=(g_N(i-1)+g_N(i+1))/2 at every interior state.
The illustration is labelled as a finite-state kernel and does not imply a particular sample path or replace the proof of almost-sure boundary hitting.
diagram_candidates.certainty: Optional explanatory diagram: the statement and proof are complete without it; a graph would make the absorbing boundary and linear harmonic function immediately visible. No proof depends on the diagram.
